correctness.rationale: Two exact exhaustive implementations cover all six-vertex matching-free 3-graphs. The primary method uses PSD principal minors; the second uses exact characteristic polynomials. They agree on the bound, all 78 labeled equality cases, five isomorphism classes, and orbit sizes.

originality.rationale: Targeted published-finding corpus and literature searches found the asymptotic Liu--O theorem and older maximal-intersecting classifications, but no source stating the exact six-vertex local spectral threshold with its five equality types.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves the first nontrivial divisible order for the new local spectral matching threshold and completely identifies equality obstructions, providing a finite benchmark for future exact and stability work.
